figurative_meaning_bn: পরের কথায় উঠে বসে এমন ব্যক্তিত্বহীন পুরুষ
figurative_meaning_en: A personality-less man who acts mechanically on others' commands
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঢেঁকিকলের মতো, যা বলা হয় তাই করে।
এই লোকটি সম্পূর্ণ ঢেঁকিকল, নিজের মতামত নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He is like a dhinki machine, doing whatever he is told.
This man is a complete puppet, with no opinion of his own.
history: The idiom derives from the traditional Bengali dhinki, a manual rice-pounding tool operated by a pulley system, symbolizing mechanical, lifeless action controlled by others.
note: Refers to a rural agrarian tool, emphasizing lack of autonomy.
